column8: javadoc
The pane id.
The command tmux reported running in the pane.
The pane's position in its window.
Whether this was its window's active pane.
The pane's title, which a program running in it can set.
The pane's working directory, as the text tmux reported.
The pane's width, in cells.
The pane's height, in cells.
The column of the pane's left edge in its window.
The row of the pane's top edge in its window.
Whether the pane touches the top of its window.
Whether the pane touches the bottom of its window.
Whether the pane touches the left of its window.
Whether the pane touches the right of its window.
The session id, as text, so it can be compared and listed.
The session name.
Whether a client was attached when this was captured.
How many windows this session holds.
This session's windows.
The underlying window id, shared by every link to it.
The window name.
Where this link sits in its session.
Whether this was its session's active window.
Whether the underlying window is linked into more than one session.
The window's width, in cells.
The window's height, in cells.
How many panes this link holds.
This link's panes.
The session this link belongs to.
The client's terminal name, which is how tmux addresses it.
The session this client was attached to, if any.
